name: Athiss
description: Athiss was the second planet in the Loro Babis system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located on the Descri Wris and was close to Korriz and Ziost. The planet was a Sith sanctuary that held the sanctuary of Vodal Kressh, a powerful Sith Lord and among the most renowned alchemists the Empire had ever known.
